closure.control: Clean child completed; an injected wait OSError killed/reaped the child with failure receipt; injected timeout plus already-exited ProcessLookupError reaped and retained timeout failure.
closure.evidence: Exact integer 180-second bound is checked before Popen. finally handles normal child exit races, attempts group termination/reaping, and records failure/unreaped state instead of success.
Every review pin collision must equal its required identity before merge. Observer self-source is now an explicit pre/post pin. These are source checks, not claims about an executed conflicting gate.

All direct output entries are inventoried; expected names must equal both full entry names and regular non-symlink file names. Extra directories, symlinks and unexpected entries fail this source expression.

conditions: Root must invoke the observer without Python optimization because admission checks use assert.
Actual gate must bind this reviewed source, observer contract, request, exact argv, output and observation paths; no actual gate was created by this review.
Underlying OS cleanup failure remains an explicit unsuccessful/unreaped result requiring root intervention, not a proved unconditional termination guarantee.

Synthetic controls replace only path globals with authored fixtures and inject wait/clock/exit-race behavior. They do not execute the real exporter, verifier, release or learner; timeout clock values are not cost measurements.
qualified_scope: Single Popen call site; atomic observation-directory admission consumes the destination before launch. Custody assumes those directories are retained.
Exact request, gate, sources, runtime, inputs, child argv/cwd and post-run output/log identities are recorded.
One independent OS child performs two full-prefix passes, with at most128 additional observation fallback proof checks; at most8574 internal proof-verification calls. Counts may be lower on failure.

Measured child CPU/RSS/process wall and observer-entry-through-post-hash wall do not include interpreter/import startup, preparation, root review or final receipt serialization. No lifetime-cost claim.
Success is process/artifact custody only; separate root qualification of native/trace candidates remains required.
read_scope: Full successor source/AST; exactly three authorized synthetic process controls. No actual export/native run or actual request/gate/prefix/output access.
